note: Fail-open presentation overlay over the real Nuxel lockscreen. Installs the controller, systemd unit, durable config and the supplied H.264/AAC clip (audio deliberately disabled). The HUD is a Wayland client over the already-running lockscreen; every failure path leaves the real lockscreen usable.
invariants: No write may resolve onto a raw partition block device, a BOOT/USERDATA/SYSTEM/RECOVERY/DTB/DTBO/VBMETA image, the radio/modem, EFS/SEC_EFS/calibration/IMEI/PIT or any partition metadata.
nuxel-wl-fb remains the single /dev/fb0 owner; the controller starts an mpv Wayland client and never opens the framebuffer.
The controller never calls the unlock action, never modifies the lockscreen, and never starts application services.
Every failure path exits 0 and leaves the real lockscreen/fallback available.
Stage -> verify SHA-256 -> atomic install -> deliberate daemon-reload -> health check -> automatic rollback on failure.

groups.component: Bounded pre-lockscreen video controller, systemd unit, durable config and supplied clip
groups.health_check: test -x /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-preload-cinema && test -f /etc/nuxel/boot/preload-cinema.json && test -f /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-preload-cinema.service && test -s /usr/share/nuxel/preload/nuxel-preloading-screen.mp4 && test "$(sha256sum /usr/share/nuxel/preload/nuxel-preloading-screen.mp4 | cut -d' ' -f1)" = b059f121e62b167fde8664e24c879ca443df8740d95441e7948abdbcc6cdbbf1 && grep -q '"asset_sha256": "b059f121e62b167fde8664e24c879ca443df8740d95441e7948abdbcc6cdbbf1"' /etc/nuxel/boot/preload-cinema.json && test -x /usr/bin/mpv && python3 -m py_compile /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-preload-cinema && systemctl is-enabled --quiet nuxel-preload-cinema.service
groups.rollback: disable nuxel-preload-cinema.service and remove its multi-user.target.wants symlink; remove the controller, unit, config, runtime clip, sidecar and doc (they did not exist before this feature), including .nuxel-staged/.nuxel-rollback copies; run systemctl daemon-reload

install_procedures.summary: Architecture, verified asset metadata/hash, readiness gates, failure policy and rollback.

validation_notes.runtime_mapping: The phone launches the launcher with ?boot=os; /run/nuxel-launcher-ready and /run/nuxel-home.state are the readiness receipts.
validation_notes.player: mpv 0.40.0-3.fc43 is packaged in the image and measured live at /usr/bin/mpv; vo=wlshm and software H.264 decode are the selected path.
validation_notes.audio: The clip contains AAC-LC stereo, but playback always uses --no-audio --mute=yes; no boot-audio setting is invented and no audio device failure can block video.
validation_notes.asset: H.264 High 1080x1920 24 fps, 144 frames, 6.016 s, 7,630,092 bytes; SHA-256 b059f121e62b167fde8664e24c879ca443df8740d95441e7948abdbcc6cdbbf1. The original bytes are packaged unchanged.
validation_notes.bounded: max_display_ms=20000, hard_timeout_ms=45000, no fixed startup sleep and no post-readiness delay.
validation_notes.readiness: Only launcher document, boot=os, display bridge FRAMES_OK/display=on and settled touch are gates; NetworkManager/Bluetooth/GNSS/audio are not.
validation_notes.one_shot: A /run/nuxel/preload-cinema.done tmpfs marker makes later manual starts return ALREADY_RAN; the unit has Restart=no.
